management_remarks: Q3 FY25 showcased the power of Reliance's consumer and digital engines, with Consolidated EBITDA reaching a record high on festive retail demand and rising Jio ARPU of Rs 203.3. Reliance Retail recorded strong footfalls across grocery, fashion, and consumer electronics, delivering 14.5% EBITDA growth year-on-year. O2C refining throughput reached optimal utilization with domestic fuel marketing volumes growing 22% year-on-year.
analyst_qa: On petrochemical cycle recovery, management emphasized that global polymer overcapacity presents persistent headwinds and margin recovery remains uncertain and volatile. While festive retail demand was healthy, non-festive discretionary apparel trends are moderating, keeping our store expansion calibrated and cautious. New Energy green hydrogen electrolyzer scaling is subject to evolving grid regulations and challenging global technology learning curves.
